item.title: IndiGo Announces ₹10,000 Compensation for Flyers Affected by Dec 3–5 Disruptions
item.description: GUWAHATI: IndiGo has announced a compensation of ₹10,000 for customers affected by its operational disruption from December 3 to 5. ALSO READ: Supreme Court To Hear Challenges To Online Gaming Ban In January 2026 The airline said the compensation will be provided as travel vouchers, which can be used for any IndiGo flight within the next 12 months. item.title: Mexico Follows in US' Footsteps, Imposes 50% Tariffs on India
item.description: GUWAHATI: Mexico has approved a sharp increase in tariffs on imports from India and several other Asian countries, marking a shift from its long-standing free-trade stance. The measure, recently passed by the Senate, introduces duties of up to 50 per cent on more than 1,400 products from nations without a formal trade agreement with Mexico. item.title: Legendary British Rockers Def Leppard to Tour India, Shillong Show on March 25
item.description: GUWAHATI: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame legends Def Leppard are officially headed to India in Spring 2026, with Shillong set to host one of the three scheduled shows. The British rock giants will perform at JN Stadium (Polo Grounds), Shillong, on March 25, as part of their India tour that also includes stops in Mumbai and Bengaluru. item.title: IAF Conducts Grand Aerial Display over Dibrugarh Base to Mark 1971 War Victory
item.description: GUWAHATI: The Indian Air Force has conducted a large aerial display over the air force station in Dibrugarh’s Mohanbari to commemorate India’s victory in the 1971 war. The event highlighted the operations undertaken during the conflict and marked the anniversary of the surrender that led to the formation of Bangladesh. item.title: Elephant Used for Tourist Rides Collapses on National Highway 37 in Kaziranga
item.description: GUWAHATI: A private elephant used to carry tourists in the Kaziranga National Park collapsed on National Highway 37 passing through the park on Thursday, December 11, leading to brief traffic disruption. The elephant, identified as Swarnamai, fell on the road after two trips with tourists in the Bagori Range of the park in the morning. item.title: Supreme Court Extends ₹50 Lakh PMGKY Insurance to All Doctors Who Died on COVID Duty
item.description: GUWAHATI: The Supreme Court on Thursday, December 11, ruled that families of doctors who died while performing their duties during the Covid-19 pandemic are entitled to benefits under the Central Government’s Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Package: Insurance Scheme for Health Workers Fighting COVID-19, even if the doctors were not formally requisitioned by the government. item.title: US Embassy Warns Tourist Visa for Indians Will Be Denied For ‘Birth Tourism’
item.description: GUWAHATI: The United States Embassy in India has issued a fresh warning to tourist-visa applicants, signalling a tougher stance on what Washington describes as birth tourism. In a post on X, the embassy said any applicant believed to be travelling to the US primarily to give birth, in order to secure American citizenship for the child, will have their visa denied immediately.
